plato-meta-tiles-main/pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
license = "MIT"
name = "plato-meta-tiles"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Meta-tiles for PLATO — tiles about tiles, enabling higher-order reasoning"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = ["requests>=2.28"]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/plato-meta-tiles"
